title: MiniMax H3 Max Text to Video
description: fal's H3 Max is a post-trained variant of MiniMax H3, tuned for stronger prompt adherence and better aesthetics while co-optimized with our custom inference stack for higher throughput with no compromises on output quality

pricing.text: Video costs $0.025 per second at 480p, $0.04 per second at 768p, and $0.08 per second at 1080p. Note: these are promotional launch rates, 50% off for a limited time. The discount ends September 30, after which 480p is $0.05/second, 768p is $0.08/second, and 1080p is $0.16/second.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: The duration of the video in seconds.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: The native generation resolution, or 1080P latent refinement from a native 768P source.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

inputs.name: prompt_expansion_mode
inputs.tooltip: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. 'disabled' skips prompt expansion. 'balanced' returns in about a second. 'quality' spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt.

inputs.name: target_audio
inputs.tooltip: Optional URL of an audio clip at least 2 seconds long (maximum 15 MB) to pin to the generated soundtrack. Longer clips are trimmed to the requested video duration, keeping the beginning. The original audio replaces the output soundtrack, padded with silence if shorter than the video, without changing playback speed. Exceptionally high sample rates may be resampled to 96 kHz. Accepts an HTTP(S) URL or a base64 data UR

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated video.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
